{{Quote|Two broadswords are better than one.''"<br />"''So are two rapiers, it appears.|[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Heavy Metal Jedi">{{CWACite|1|Heavy Metal Jedi}}</ref>}}
A '''rapier''' was a type of of [[Sword/Legends|sword]] that was typically made of [[flexisteel]] and used for [[fencing]]. [[Saber]]s, [[foil]]s, and [[epée]]s were specific types of rapier.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The weapons were known for their greater precision. In contrast to the [[Broadsword/Legends|broadsword]], it also served as a metaphor for a style of combat relying predominantly on strategy.
